Name: Stardew Valley NPC Creator A visual tool for creating custom NPCs
Author: jefrit88
Description:
Hi, umm, I'm currently going to abandon the tool, perhaps permanently. But if anyone wants to continue with it, please contact me. My current emotional state doesn't allow me to continue, but it's an ambitious and large project. I'm abandoning it mainly because I feel it's not attracting the attention or views I expected. Perhaps if someone else publishes it, it will be more successful. It already has a foundation; it just needs someone determined not to give up and do everything possible for the project. This message was posted on February 11, 2026.






Want to add your own characters (NPCs) to Stardew Valley without any hassle? This tool lets you do it easily, visually, and directly. With Stardew Valley NPC Creator, you can design NPCs with their data, appearance, dialogue, schedules, and preferences; and generate a ready-to-install mod compatible with game version 1.6+.
Changelog on itch.io
Check out my sprite generator, which is in beta, here: https://jefri88.itch.io/stardew-valley-character-sprite-maker
Main features:
Full visual editor: Define name, author, version, description, gender, age, birthday, and personality.
Custom appearance: Allows you to upload sprites and portraits by season.
Advanced gift system: Includes a database of approximately 150 common items for easy preference assignment, with a search function, category filters, and customizable messages.
Dialogue editor: Create dialogues by day of the week and season. with many predefined keys (approximately 250) to facilitate creation.
Schedule and Routine Editor: visual table for creating NPC routines, location viewer with coordinates, integration with game maps; includes a ready-to-use predefined routine. Automatic Mod Generation: The tool generates all the necessary files for use with Content Patcher; produces a ZIP file ready to install in the Stardew Valley folder. Compatible with SMAPI + Content Patcher.
Mods
Fully browser-based operation: 100% JavaScript, no dependencies; no installation required.
Requirements to use/install the generated mod:
SMAPI must be installed as a mod loader.
Content Patcher must be installed.
A modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, etc.) to use the editor.
How to use (for the player/modder):
Access the tool and fill out the forms with the NPC information (name, details, appearance, likes, dialogue, schedule). Upload your sprites and portraits according to the game's format.
Generate the mod with one click: the tool will create the necessary files.
Download the resulting ZIP file. Extract the contents to your Stardew Valley/Mods/ folder.
Launch the game with SMAPI. The NPC should now load.
Note/Legal Notices:
This is an unofficial community tool.
It requires basic modding knowledge (sprites in the correct format, basic understanding of mods).
Sprites/portraits must follow the game's format.
License/Credits:
Tool created by jefri88.
Based on the Stardew Valley game by ConcernedApe.
Use Content Patcher and respect the Stardew Valley modding community.
